title: MCP Audio Tools
description: Split audio into files every N seconds, export the selection, add interval labels and import any audio file as a track. Companion of audacity-mcp-server.

audacity.effects.title: Split into Files (MCP)
audacity.effects.description: Write the selection (or each selected track) as consecutive files of N seconds.

audacity.effects.title: Export Selection to File (MCP)
audacity.effects.description: Write the selected audio to one file (WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF, CAF, W64).

audacity.effects.title: Labels Every N Seconds (MCP)
audacity.effects.description: Add a label track with one region label every N seconds of the selection.

audacity.effects.title: Import Audio File as Track (MCP)
audacity.effects.description: Add any audio file (WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, MP3, AIFF...) as a new track.
